setup.text:
Connect your agent

Claude Code on macOS/Linux · Python 3 required. This installs a project-local PostToolUse hook. Connecting the browser only reads history; it does not configure your coding client.

Download hook Save cbm-atlas-trace.py in Downloads, or adjust its path in the command below.
Review and run this command in your terminal. It copies the hook into .claude/hooks/ and adds it to .claude/settings.local.json, preserving unrelated settings. Conflicting existing hooks are refused.
python3 ~/Downloads/cbm-atlas-trace.py --install-claude --root '/Users/bernhard/Desktop/codebasememorymcp_branch 2068' --project 'cbm-pr2068' --daemon-url 'http://127.0.0.1:9749'
Copy setup command
Start a new Claude Code session in that repository and perform a tool call. Then choose Load recorded activity here. A new recorded event is the evidence that the hook reached this daemon.

Destination: http://127.0.0.1:9749/api/agent-events · Project: cbm-pr2068. No bridge or extra listener. Pending events retry on the next tool call.

The hook records tool names, paths, timestamps, optional line spans and up to 180 characters of a command or search pattern. It records no file contents or tool results. Metadata stays in the local daemon; commands and paths can still contain sensitive information.

To remove it, delete only the entry referencing cbm-atlas-trace.py from this project's PostToolUse hooks. Other coding clients need their own event adapter; their activity is not inferred.
